rows.text: walks a pointer from `02099010` up to and including `02099520` in `0x288` steps (three records) and returns 1 at the first record whose byte `[pointer - 0x1F0]` has bit 0 set and whose byte `[pointer]` has bit 2 set; returns 0 when no record matches
sign-extends `ecx`, multiplies it by `0x288`, adds `02098E10` and tail-jumps to a 475-byte routine with that record address in `rcx` and `edx = 1`
keeps `ecx`, calls `WorldTransition_GetActiveOrPendingFieldId()` and tail-jumps to a 124-byte two-argument routine with the kept `ecx` as the first argument and the returned value in `edx`

switches on dword `[rcx + 0xE4]`: when it is 1 and a 23-byte nonzero-to-1 predicate returns nonzero, it calls a 108-byte four-slot byte refresher and stores 2 to `+0xE4`; when it is 2 and the same predicate returns nonzero, it clears bit 0 of dword `+0xE8` and stores 1 to `+0xE4` when that bit was set, else stores 0 to `+0xE4`; any other value, or a zero predicate, returns with no store
when dword `022BDEB8` is nonzero, passes it in `ecx` to a 58-byte dispatcher keyed on the top four bits of its argument and then stores 0 to `022BDEB8`; otherwise returns without a call
stores 1 to byte `022BDD5C` and stores `cl`, `dl`, `r8b` and `r9b` to bytes `022BDD58`, `022BDD59`, `022BDD5A` and `022BDD5B`
stores 1 to dword `022CA45C` when `ecx` is zero, else 0
